description: Shared Renovate policy for repositories adopting the coding-agent conventions.

packageRules.description: Group routine npm and Bun minor and patch upgrades into a single bounded check
Group routine Cargo minor and patch upgrades without coupling them to JavaScript validation
web-sys and js-sys require the exact wasm-bindgen release they were published with; bumping them separately breaks the build, so the wasm-bindgen crate family and CLI always move together.

Group all digest updates into one PR. Crates and packages from one git repository must move together: one PR per crate split a repository across two revisions and broke builds (owner decision 2026-10-21).

Packages consumed as commit pins on publish branches (input-bindings dist/<package>, platform-packages dist/i18n, the settings browser distribution): digest updates follow the default branch, whose commits are not installable packages.
